contents.text: Train ticket is a item that allows redstone to react depending on which item a player is holding
To start, craft a train ticket by combining paper and a bundle
for the detection system, place from top to bottom, a rail, a barrel, and a copper bulb
Passing over the rail on a minecart while holding the train ticket in the main hand activates the detection.
The system looks for any item that occurs both in the barrel and the train ticket. If it finds at leat one it activates the bulb.
If it doesn't detect any item that occurs in both locations then the bulb switches off.
